nurse.text: Ey up, love! Welcome to Leeds Sanctuary. Pop your team on the counter. They look like they've walked over from Saddleworth.
What can we do for you?

then.text: Sit yourself down. There's a brew in the pot and a curd tart on the side. Hands off the last slice, that's mine.
There, champion. All patched up. Mind the buses on the Headrow, they don't stop for anyone, us included.
The Ark's in the corner. Somebody's left a scarf on it. Leeds colours. Leave it, it's lucky.

else.text: No bother. Off you go, and say hello to the lions for me.
